Ritika Malhotra  
Washington, DC | ritika.malhotra@email.com | (202) 555-0198 | linkedin.com/in/ritikamalhotra  

A results-oriented embedded systems engineer specializing in fintech hardware-software integration. Proven ability to design reliable, low-latency solutions for IoT-enabled financial infrastructure. Focus on optimizing edge computing architectures and real-time data protocols.  

**Projects**  
*IoT Payment Terminal Firmware (2022–2023)*  
Developed firmware for IoT-enabled payment terminals, enabling secure transaction processing via MQTT protocol. Reduced firmware boot time by 25% through optimized memory management. Integrated secure boot mechanisms to prevent unauthorized firmware updates.  

*Biometric Authentication Module (2023)*  
Led sensor integration for biometric authentication modules, achieving 98.5% reliability in hardware-software co-design. Implemented calibration routines to minimize sensor drift under varying environmental conditions. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align hardware specifications with security compliance standards.  

*Edge Computing for Fraud Detection (2024)*  
Architected edge computing solutions for latency-critical fraud detection systems, reducing processing time by 40% through distributed computation. Designed lightweight RTOS-based frameworks to prioritize real-time data ingestion. Integrated hardware accelerators to enhance cryptographic operations.
